(rule!
  (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g)
    (lambda (r c)
      (let* ((vals (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) (row-at g r)))
             (colors (remove-duplicates vals)))
        (if (and (= (length colors) 1) (= (length vals) 2))
            (let* ((color (first colors))
                   (cols (map second (filter (lambda (cell) (= (third cell) color))
                                             (for/list ([cc (in-range (cols g))])
                                               (list r cc (at g r cc)))))))
              (if (and (>= c (apply min cols)) (<= c (apply max cols))) color (at g r c)))
            (at g r c))))))

(rule! (lambda (g) (let* ((filled (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g)
      (lambda (r c)
        (let* ((row (row-at g r))
               (vals (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) row))
               (colors (remove-duplicates vals))
               (cs (filter (lambda (cc) (not (= (at g r cc) 0))) (range (cols g)))))
          (if (and (= (length vals) 2) (= (length colors) 1))
              (if (and (>= c (first cs)) (<= c (last cs))) (first vals) (at g r c))
              (at g r c))))))) (let* ((source filled)
                 (colors (remove-duplicates (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) (apply append source)))))
            (if (null? colors) filled
                (let* ((selected (pick-max colors (lambda (color) (count-color source color)))))
                  (grid-from-fn (rows filled) (cols filled)
                    (lambda (r c) (if (= (at filled r c) selected) selected 0)))))))))
